Joins Montgomery tracts to 2026 code-violation totals and CDC adult high-blood-pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 residents, keeps only non-null paired tracts, and returns the correlation and paired count with tracts ranked by violation rate.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    t.geoid AS geoid,
    CAST(COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS code_violations_total,
    CAST(c.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(c.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) * 1000.0 AS code_violations_rate_per_1000_residents,
    CAST(c.bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts v
    ON t.geoid = v.geoid
   AND v.run_id = 'r_20261026_a4d977'
   AND v.source = 'm1_city'
   AND v.grp = 'all'
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_a4d977_m2_cdc c
    ON t.geoid = c.tractfips
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  code_violations_rate_per_1000_residents,
  code_violations_total,
  totalpopulation,
  high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  CORR(code_violations_rate_per_1000_residents, high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM base
WHERE code_violations_rate_per_1000_residents IS NOT NULL
  AND high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY code_violations_rate_per_1000_residents DESC, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
